ARTS340 - Sculpture II
Prerequisite: ARTS 104 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 125 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 130 with a minimum grade of "C-": and ARTS 140 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 240 with a minimum grade of "C-"; and either ARTH 103 with a minimum grade of "C-" or ARTH 104 with a minimum grade of "C-"; or consent of instructor Advanced projects will be undertaken in design and media. Meets six hours weekly. Offered annually. Additional fee required.

ARTS357 - Printmaking III
Prerequisite: ARTS 355 with a minimum grade of "C"; or consent of instructor Work will focus on complex color printing techniques in the various media of multi-plate lithography, multi-plate intaglio, multi-block relief and combination media prints. Discussions will focus on refinement of technique and content development. Meets six hours weekly. Offered annually. Additional fee required.

ARTS358 - Book Arts II
Prerequisite: ARTS 104 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 125 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 130 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 140 with a minimum grade of "C-" and ARTS 258 with a minimum grade of "C-"; and either ARTH 103 with a minimum grade of "C-" or ARTH 104 with a minimum grade of "C-"; or consent of instructor This course is a continuation of the techniques and ideas explored in ARTS 258 - Bookbinding and Book Arts I. ARTS362 - Graphic Design III
Prerequisite: ARTS 361 with a minimum grade of "C-" or consent of instructor This course is an advanced study in design. Similarly to a design studio, agency or in-house environment, students explore and create using multi-media techniques. Integration of illustration, design and typography is encouraged as a way to create work that expresses creative vision and intention. In preparation for both specialized studio work and personal creative growth, students are required to complete course projects as well as a self-directed project involving concept development, a written proposal, production and presentation of the project to the class. Meets six hours weekly. Offered fall semester. Additional fee required.
